articles.title: Government approves senior bureaucrats' postings to IMF, ADB
articles.summary: India's Centre has approved key foreign postings for senior officials to influential international financial institutions. These include significant positions at the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in Washington and the Asian Development Bank (ADB) in the Philippines. This highlights India's active engagement in global economic governance, offering civil servants opportunities to represent national interests on an international stage.

articles.title: SpaceX rocket segment to crash into the moon: What happened?
articles.summary: A SpaceX rocket booster, adrift in space since last year, is believed to have impacted the moon at high speed on Wednesday. This marks the first unintentional lunar impact of space debris, creating a new crater for scientific observation. While not visible to the naked eye, the event offers a unique opportunity to study the moon's subsurface and the dynamics of such impacts, providing valuable data for future space missions.
